---
title: "Interactive Green Area Map of Düsseldorf"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

adminareas <- st_read("gis_osm_adminareas_a_free_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)
landuse <- st_read("gis_osm_landuse_a_free_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)
water <- st_read("gis_osm_water_a_free_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)
roads <- st_read("gis_osm_roads_free_1.shp", quiet = TRUE)

adminareas <- st_set_crs(adminareas, 4326)
landuse <- st_set_crs(landuse, 4326)
water <- st_set_crs(water, 4326)
roads <- st_set_crs(roads, 4326)

dusseldorf_boundary <- adminareas |>
  filter(name == "Düsseldorf")

parks <- landuse |>
  filter(fclass %in% c("park", "forest", "grass", "recreation_ground", "meadow"))

parks_clipped <- st_intersection(st_make_valid(parks), st_make_valid(dusseldorf_boundary))

residential <- landuse |>
  filter(fclass == "residential")

residential_clipped <- st_intersection(st_make_valid(residential), st_make_valid(dusseldorf_boundary))

water_clipped <- st_intersection(st_make_valid(water), st_make_valid(dusseldorf_boundary))

roads_clipped <- st_intersection(st_make_valid(roads), st_make_valid(dusseldorf_boundary))

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = dusseldorf_boundary,
    fillColor = "#f2f2f2",
    fillOpacity = 0.25,
    color = "#111111",
    weight = 2,
    group = "Düsseldorf Boundary"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = residential_clipped,
    fillColor = "#666666",
    fillOpacity = 0.55,
    color = NA,
    popup = ~paste("Land use:", fclass),
    group = "Residential Areas"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = parks_clipped,
    fillColor = "#2E7D32",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = NA,
    popup = ~paste("Green area:", fclass),
    group = "Green Areas"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = water_clipped,
    fillColor = "#64B5F6",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = NA,
    popup = ~paste("Water:", fclass),
    group = "Water"
  ) |>
  addPolylines(
    data = roads_clipped,
    color = "#444444",
    weight = 0.6,
    opacity = 0.55,
    popup = ~paste("Road type:", fclass),
    group = "Roads"
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Düsseldorf Boundary",
      "Residential Areas",
      "Green Areas",
      "Water",
      "Roads"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")
```
